records.observation: Large gray upright and sloping sheets surround the blue slats above a curved lower shell. The layered body is malformed and the blue region is not convincingly integrated into a usable seat; its supporting geometry is unclear.

A fence-like gray panel hangs below one side of the blue seat, while several gray bars float above it with visible gaps in both oblique views. The top also has an overlapping gray strip; the body and load-bearing support are incomplete or ambiguous.

The gray output is a recognizable bench with end supports, a seat plank and an upright back. The preserved blue seat is higher than the gray sitting plank and sits midway up the back, creating a separate seating level.

A regular gray two-level frame has corner legs, a broad upper slab and a lower shelf. The curved blue strip is located on the lower level, far beneath the gray top, so the preserved seat is not adopted as the usable upper surface.
